spans.s: 1. यौन mf(ई)n. (fr. योनि) relating to the womb or place of birth, uterine, W.
relating to or resulting from or connected by marriage, Mn.; MBh. &c.
matrimonial connection, conjugal alliance, relationship by marriage, ib.
the ceremony on conception (= गर्भाधान), L.
2. यौन m. pl. N. of a people (prob. = यवन), MBh.
यौन—सम्बन्ध m. relationship by marriage, affinity, MW.
moderate wind (neither too mild nor too strong), L.
